Full visual text Unicode grapheme segmentation precedes run projection; ordered visual run starts permit cursor path, otherwise full scan. Cross-run graphemes aggregate source envelope, direction from first intersecting run, and equal lengths do not validate text identity or UTF8 offsets.

Ordered disjoint source ranges select binary caret/range paths; repeated or unordered ranges choose linear matching and source-envelope indexes. Source-range selection retains complete clusters and merges visual adjacency only, allowing discontiguous bidi pieces.
